issuing_body: 文化庁著作権課著作物流通推進室
implementation_notes: This notice clarifies that on-site inspections and information collection under Copyright Act Articles 104-28(1) and 104-41(1) may be conducted using online meeting systems or other digital technologies when the Commissioner of the Agency for Cultural Affairs deems it necessary, in line with digital reform principles from the Digital Extraordinary Administrative Research Committee.
